about: Autonomy policy. Read by the server at start, never by the model. Changing it needs a file edit and a new case database; no prompt, brief or chat message can change it.

specialist_review.means: Specialists prepare a plan. They cannot approve, send, revoke or reconcile money.

publish_plan.means: The owner must allow publication of the current plan. Publishing never grants payment permission.

refund.means: One exact refund, approved by the owner, for one capture and amount, within the limit.

reconcile.means: A read only check of a known provider record. It runs without new approval and never sends money.
